Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Classic Ceiling Pendant Chandelier Fixture With White Drum Shade- 20 x 20 x 42 Inches, Black
Colors: Black
Materials: Metal
A modern spin on the classic chandelier, this light fixture has four arms covered by one rectangular shade. The metal hardware combines with a white fabric shade to blend with your existing styles. Modern with classic touches Metal hardware with black finish and fabric shade Creates a warm ambiance for a living room or dining room 42"H x 20"W x 20"D Product is hardwired (professional installation recommended) For indoor use only
